comments.author: @Dispalzz
comments.text:
My uncle lived in The Villages for many years. He loved it. It is not entirely accurate, however, that under 55 is banned. At least one spouse (or partner I assume) must be 55 in order to buy property. The other can be younger as long as one is the right age. There are a few sections that permit under 55 to buy (family areas). There is a school system in The Villages. The students are from the few areas where under 55 is allowed to live and also from employees who work the various stores, restaurants, health care, and other industries in The Villages. The school is pretty exclusive due to the restrictions. Golf carts are everywhere! I loved that we could go anywhere in town on the golf cart. 

Overall, I love The Villages and am considering retiring there. I'm over 55 and I think it would be great to have a town so geared toward retirement!
